answer: Optimization is needed. Catch IndexOutOfBoundsException and NullPointerException around the QueryChunker.chunk(...) call (lines 5-17 in original snippet).
remark: Added one try-catch block around the chunk call. It catches IndexOutOfBoundsException (from subList inside chunk when chunkSize is negative) and NullPointerException (from Optional.of when forcedId.getForcedId() is null). If either exception occurs, the method gracefully continues to fill missing PIDs with Optional.empty() in the subsequent loop.
analysis: The method retrieves cached mappings for given PIDs, then queries the database for missing ones via a chunked query, and finally fills any remaining with Optional.empty(). The chunk method may throw IndexOutOfBoundsException if the internal chunk size is negative. Inside the lambda, Optional.of(forcedId.getForcedId()) throws NullPointerException if getForcedId() returns null. Both are runtime exceptions that will disrupt execution if uncaught. Since both occur during the chunk call (the lambda is executed within chunk), a single try-catch around the chunk call can catch both exceptions, preventing premature termination and allowing the method to continue with the fallback loop.
